info.title: gl (GL — configuration and rule engine)
info.description: Tenant-scoped, versioned, effective-dated GL configuration. Every non-public operation requires the authenticated user (x-mycel-user, set by the app core) and the tenant (x-gl-tenant), and a role in that tenant: readers (any role) read; CONFIG_EDITOR creates, edits and validates; CONFIG_APPROVER approves and retires (never a version they changed: 403 SELF_APPROVAL); GL_ADMIN manages roles. Every change requires a reason.

Where the version stands in the GL flow: configured, validated, approved, required fields, mapped, collected, simulated, posted, subledger, reconciled, reported — stages not built yet say NOT_IMPLEMENTED with their story

post.summary: Validate edited content without saving it, and list the items it changes against the stored version (editors)

Posting preview (US-012, US-013; read-only): the posting rule that applies to a sample event (and every rule considered, with why), the journal legs it produces by accounting class (side, amount at currency minor units, legal entity, keys, dimensions, lineage), the account each leg is assigned on the book date with the assignment rule, configuration version and why, skipped legs with reasons, and the balance per entity and currency. Refusals: MISSING_RULE, AMBIGUOUS_RULE, NULL_AMOUNT, UNROUNDED_AMOUNT, MISSING_ENTITY, UNBALANCED, MISSING_BOOK_DATE, MISSING_ACCOUNT, AMBIGUOUS_ASSIGNMENT and the US-011 posting-gate codes (with the plan in detail).

get.summary: Whether AI drafting from a BRD is available on this server, with the provider and model, or why not (no settings file, no key, switched off). The key is never returned.

post.summary: Read a business requirements document (Word .docx, text or Markdown, at most 1.5 MB) into text for the AI steps. Draft versions, CONFIG_EDITOR. Nothing is sent to the AI and nothing is stored.

409.description: the version is not a draft

post.summary: One AI step from a BRD against the draft as it is: events, then measures, then formulas, then debit/credit lines with synthetic test cases (LHS = RHS). The proposal quotes its BRD evidence (checked against the text), is validated by the engine and repaired by the AI at most 3 times; account numbers and closed-dimension values are left to a person (gaps). Nothing is saved: the person approves and the studio saves with PUT and origin AI_STEP. Draft versions, CONFIG_EDITOR.

200.description: configId, version, contentDigest, proposal {step, provider, model, items, gaps, questions, notes, findings, problems, cases, balance, attempts, usage}

409.description: the version is not a draft

503.description: AI_UNAVAILABLE: not set up, or the provider failed

origin.description: set when the change was proposed by an AI step and approved by the caller; recorded in the audit trail

gl_EventInput.description: A sample canonical event (flat form). Simulation only: nothing is stored.

tenantId.description: Defaults to the caller tenant (x-gl-tenant); another tenant is refused (TENANT_MISMATCH) without being read.

sourceEventVersion.description: With sourceSystem and sourceEventId, the dedup identity (US-010).

keys.description: Business keys at event level (US-010), e.g. POLICY_NO.

asOf.description: Processing date for period decisions (US-009); default: the transaction date.

lists.description: 1:N items, e.g. ALLOCATION_LIST; item keys and measures as flat fields.

explanation.description: Per event: fields (in manifest order) with reasons and via chains, lists, unused fields
